## tmh delete

Send a DELETE request to any API path

### Synopsis

Sends a DELETE request to a path relative to the API base URL, which already ends in /v1, with the same authentication and error handling as the resource commands. Transient failures are never retried, since the delete may already have happened. A literal {orgId} in the path is replaced by the Organization your credentials are bound to.

```
tmh delete <path> [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  tmh delete /organizations/{orgId}/webhook-subscriptions/whs_123
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help                help for delete
      --if-match string     send If-Match with this ETag, for a conditional write
      --no-auth             send no Access token, even when logged in; public operations such as /courses never get one
      --query stringArray   query parameter as key=value; repeatable
```
